title: ModelPrediction
description: Standardized prediction output emitted by the Spandana LTC inference engine (inference/predict.py::LTCInferenceEngine) for the backend/dashboard to consume.

health_score.description: 0 = fully faulty, 100 = fully healthy. Derived as (1 - fault_probability) * 100.

anomaly_score.description: Unsupervised out-of-distribution signal. Falls back to fault_probability when no trained reconstruction-error scorer (see augmentation/vae.py) is attached.

predicted_fault.description: Human-readable predicted condition, e.g. 'Healthy', 'Inner Race Fault', 'Outer Race Fault', 'Ball/Roller Fault', 'Combined Inner+Outer Fault'.

prediction_confidence.description: Softmax probability of the predicted class.

remaining_useful_life_hours.description: Linear-trend extrapolation of health_score to zero, in hours. Present only when the machine has enough prediction history (>=5 points) AND a clearly declining trend; null otherwise -- never fabricated from insufficient data.

recommended_action.description: Rule-based maintenance recommendation (inference/decision_rules.py) -- deliberately not model-generated, for auditability.
